A nominally autonomous sub-state with its own legal and currency systems: a civil-law framework inherited from a distant former administering power, an economy dominated by casino and resort tourism, no documented anti-trans enforcement; a small local scene; the gap with the much larger adjacent state's regime reflects the separate local legal system.

The underlying evidence base is that of the much larger adjacent state, adapted for local conditions.
